title: Toward Compact Fiber In-line Nonlinear Devices via Highly Efficient Nanophotonic Cavity Interface
summary: Compact and efficient frequency conversion within optical fibers is highly desirable for nonlinear and quantum photonic technologies, yet it remains challenging due to weak nonlinear interactions and limited coupling efficiencies onto optical fibers. Here, we demonstrate resonantly enhanced second-harmonic generation (SHG) through the all-fiber integration of a gallium nitride (GaN) hole-type circular Bragg grating (h-CBG) cavity, directly transferred onto a standard optical fiber.
